summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, disclosing entry into a Note Purchase Agreement for a $3,000,000 convertible promissory note in a registered direct offering. The note bears 8% annual interest, matures in 18 months, and is convertible into Class A ordinary shares at 90% of the lowest daily trading price, subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The offering closed the same day with gross proceeds of $3 million, issued via a shelf takedown. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, as it involves a standard convertible debt issuance under an existing shelf registration.
